# t1-paste

> A free, open-source, agent-first pastebin. Create a text paste and get a short URL back.

## Create a paste

```bash
curl -sS --data-binary @file.txt http://localhost:3000/api/pastes
```

The response is a plain URL when `Accept: text/plain` is set.

Options:

- `?expires=1h` (also `1d`, `7d`)
- `?visibility=public` or `unlisted` (default)
- `?lang=typescript`
- `?burn=1` (unlisted only)
- `x-paste-password` header for password-protected pastes
- `?slug=my-slug` (accounts only)

## Read a paste

```bash
GET /api/pastes/:slug
GET /api/pastes/:slug/raw
GET /api/pastes/:slug/meta
```

## Agent auth

Anonymous paste creation requires no authentication. For private or 30-day
pastes, register an anonymous agent account through auth.md:

```bash
t1 agent register
t1 agent status
```

Or follow the protocol directly:

```bash
curl http://localhost:3000/auth.md
```

The service supports anonymous registration only. There are no human accounts,
`service_auth`, claim ceremonies, or ID-JAG assertions.

## CLI

```bash
curl -fsSL http://localhost:3000/install.sh | sh
t1 paste file.txt
t1 paste - < file.txt
t1 get http://localhost:3000/abc123
t1 agent register
```

The CLI is optional. If `t1` is unavailable, use the `curl` API path above.
The recommended install is `cargo install t1-cli --locked`; it requires Rust.

For the local POC, use `T1_API_URL=http://localhost:8787`. A link created
against `localhost` only works on that machine.

## Limits

- 256 KB of UTF-8 text per paste.
- 7-day maximum expiry for anonymous pastes.
- 30-day maximum for accounts and claimed agents.
- Text only. No files, images, or binary uploads.
- Unlisted by default. No global public explore page.

## Machine-readable docs

- [AGENTS.md](http://localhost:3000/AGENTS.md)
- [auth.md](http://localhost:3000/auth.md)
- [OpenAPI](http://localhost:3000/openapi.json)
